summary: docsic 0.5.0: `sweep: carry` stages note sweep doc edits so they ride the next PR opened on a branch, whoever opens it; the Stop hook asks the agent to apply them, and a docs-only PR is the fallback only after 7 days with no PR to carry them.
why: Docs-only sweep PRs added noise in repos where a PR always comes along soon; the lever is a PR existing, not the skill that opens it.
